# Cross-dataset sample table

```{r combine-tables}
#| echo: false
all_samples <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results), function(ds) {
  # The sample table is rebuilt, not read from the cache, so it is never stale. A
  # repository that does not answer stops here, before rbind() fails on the stub.
  meta <- tryCatch(load_metadata(ds), error = function(e) {
    if (is_network_error(e)) stop(e)
    data.frame(file = basename(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]))
  })
  .m <- resolve_isobars(per_target(results[[ds]], "metrics"),
                        conf_final, ds, results[[ds]]$rt_anchor)
  st <- build_sample_table(.m, basename(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]), meta, dedup = TRUE)
  # Keep only files still in the current bio_files: a cached extraction can hold files
  # a later QC rule removed.
  keep <- norm_file_key(st$file) %in% norm_file_key(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]])
  cbind(dataset_id = ds, assay = results[[ds]]$assay, st[keep, , drop = FALSE],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

# Files with no metadata are kept for the presence record but excluded from
# every stratified analysis below.
all_samples$has_metadata <- {
  key <- paste0(all_samples$dataset_id, "|",
                basename(as.character(all_samples$file)))
  hit <- has_metadata_lookup[key]
  ifelse(is.na(hit), FALSE, unname(hit))
}

write.csv(all_samples, "artifacts/sample_table_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Datasets processed :", length(results), "\n")
cat("Total rows         :", nrow(all_samples),
    "  (with metadata:", sum(all_samples$has_metadata),
    "| record-only:", sum(!all_samples$has_metadata), ")\n")
```

`sample_table_all.csv` is one row per subject (the `build_sample_table()`
dedup). Per-file and longitudinal analyses (`06`) need the rows *before* that
dedup, so we also write a per-file table, keeping `subject_id` (+ a
`subject_key` fallback) so those analyses aggregate to one-per-subject
themselves; the rows are not independent.

```{r combine-tables-perfile}
#| echo: false
getcol <- function(df, nm)
  if (nm %in% names(df)) as.character(df[[nm]]) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))

all_samples_perfile <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(results), function(ds) {
  r    <- results[[ds]]
  meta <- tryCatch(load_metadata(ds), error = function(e) {
    if (is_network_error(e)) stop(e)   # as in combine-tables
    data.frame(file = basename(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]))
  })
  .m   <- resolve_isobars(per_target(r, "metrics"), conf_final, ds, r$rt_anchor)
  st   <- build_sample_table(.m, basename(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]), meta, dedup = FALSE)
  st$subject_key <- dplyr::coalesce(getcol(st, "subject_id"),
                                    getcol(st, "sample_name"), as.character(st$file))
  cbind(dataset_id = ds, assay = r$assay, st, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(all_samples_perfile, "artifacts/sample_table_perfile.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("One row per raw file:", nrow(all_samples_perfile),
    "| one row per subject-sample after collapsing repeat files:", nrow(all_samples), "\n")
```

## Positive control: files where MS2 already confirmed the compound

Where SIRIUS confirmed a compound's MS2 spectrum in a file, the compound is in
that file, so MS1 extraction must find it there too. A confirmed file it misses
is propagation losing real signal rather than biology, and the table names the
rule behind each miss. A `truncated` detection counts as found: its peak ran
into empty scans before falling to half height, so it is detected but carries
no area.

```{r positive-control}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
pc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(results), function(ds) {
  fb   <- basename(as.character(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]))
  bare <- function(x) norm_file_key(to_bare_name(basename(as.character(x)), fb))
  st   <- all_samples_perfile[all_samples_perfile$dataset_id == ds, ]
  st$k <- norm_file_key(st$file)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(roles, function(role) {
    pre <- target_prefix(role)
    ck  <- unique(bare(conf_final$source_file[conf_final$dataset_id == ds &
                                              conf_final$role == role]))
    s   <- st[st$k %in% ck, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(s)) return(NULL)
    det <- s[[paste0(pre, "_detected")]] %in% TRUE
    why <- as.character(s[[paste0(pre, "_gate")]]); why[is.na(why)] <- "no peak in window"
    tab <- sort(table(why[!det]), decreasing = TRUE)
    data.frame(dataset = short_ds(ds, names(results)), compound = role, confirmed = nrow(s),
               detected = sum(det),
               by_hand = sum(det & why == "manual accept"),
               truncated = sum(det & s[[paste0(pre, "_truncated")]] %in% TRUE),
               missed = sum(!det),
               why_missed = if (length(tab)) paste0(names(tab), " (", tab, ")", collapse = "; ") else "",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))
write.csv(pc, "artifacts/positive_control.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat(knitr::kable(pc, row.names = FALSE,
                 col.names = c("dataset", "compound", "MS2-confirmed files", "MS1 detected",
                               "of which accepted by hand", "of which truncated", "missed",
                               "why missed"),
                 caption = sprintf(paste(
                   "Positive control: %d of %d MS2-confirmed files are detected at MS1,",
                   "%d of them accepted by hand."),
                   sum(pc$detected), sum(pc$confirmed), sum(pc$by_hand))), sep = "\n")
```

```{r fig-pc-misses, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 0.6 + 1.9 * max(1, ceiling(sum(pc$missed) / 4))}
# Every miss of the table above, one panel each: trace, window, MS2 times and apex.
# A file's key within its assay, as the table above matches files.
key_in <- function(ds, x)
  norm_file_key(to_bare_name(basename(as.character(x)),
                             basename(as.character(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]))))
miss <- as.data.frame(dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(results), function(ds) {
  st <- all_samples_perfile[all_samples_perfile$dataset_id == ds, ]
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(roles, function(role) {
    pre <- target_prefix(role)
    ck  <- key_in(ds, conf_final$source_file[conf_final$dataset_id == ds &
                                             conf_final$role == role])
    s   <- st[norm_file_key(st$file) %in% ck &
              !(st[[paste0(pre, "_detected")]] %in% TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(s)) return(NULL)
    why <- as.character(s[[paste0(pre, "_gate")]]); why[is.na(why)] <- "no peak in window"
    data.frame(dataset_id = ds, role = role, pre = pre, file = s$file, reason = why,
               apex_rt = s[[paste0(pre, "_apex_rt")]])
  }))
})))
stopifnot(nrow(miss) == sum(pc$missed))

# A file name without its accession and extension, cut in the middle if long.
short_file <- function(f) {
  f <- sub("[.][^.]*$", "", sub("^(MSV|MTBLS|ST)[0-9]+[_-]", "", basename(f)))
  ifelse(nchar(f) > 28, paste0(substr(f, 1, 13), "...", substring(f, nchar(f) - 11)), f)
}
miss_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(miss)), function(i) {
  m   <- miss[i, ]
  r   <- results[[m$dataset_id]]
  k   <- norm_file_key(m$file)
  win <- r$rt_anchor[[m$pre]]$win
  ms2 <- unique(as.numeric(conf_final$rt[conf_final$dataset_id == m$dataset_id &
                                         conf_final$role == m$role &
                                         key_in(m$dataset_id, conf_final$source_file) == k]))
  # The window and 25 s either side, wider where a confirmed spectrum or the apex lies outside.
  xr  <- range(win + c(-25, 25), ms2 - 5, ms2 + 5, m$apex_rt, na.rm = TRUE)
  chr <- r[[paste0("chr_", m$pre)]]
  j   <- match(k, key_in(m$dataset_id, dataOrigin(chr)))
  pd  <- if (is.na(j)) data.frame(rtime = numeric(), intensity = numeric()) else
    as.data.frame(Chromatograms::peaksData(chr)[[j]])
  pd  <- pd[pd$rtime >= xr[1] & pd$rtime <= xr[2], ]
  id  <- sprintf("%03d", i)
  pd$id  <- rep(id, nrow(pd))
  # A run of scans with signal is one line; an empty scan breaks it.
  pd$run <- paste(id, cumsum(!is.finite(pd$intensity)))
  on  <- pd[is.finite(pd$intensity), ]
  list(label = paste0(short_ds(m$dataset_id, names(results)), ", ",
                      sub("^L-", "", target_name[[m$role]]),
                      "\n", short_file(m$file), "\n", m$reason),
       trace = on,
       empty = pd[!is.finite(pd$intensity), ],
       # The scan the picker took as apex; none where it found no peak.
       apex  = on[which.min(abs(on$rtime - m$apex_rt)), ],
       ms2   = data.frame(id = rep(id, length(ms2)), rtime = ms2),
       win   = data.frame(id = id, lo = win[1], hi = win[2]),
       lim   = data.frame(id = id, rtime = xr, intensity = 0))
})

by_reason <- sort(table(miss$reason), decreasing = TRUE)
miss_note <- if (nrow(miss))
  paste0("The figure draws each of the ", nrow(miss), " misses, one panel per file and target: ",
         paste0(names(by_reason), " (", by_reason, ")", collapse = ", "), ".") else
  "No MS2-confirmed file is missed, so there is nothing to draw."

miss_h <- 0.6 + 1.9 * max(1, ceiling(nrow(miss) / 4))   # inches: four panels per row
if (nrow(miss)) {
  part <- function(k) do.call(rbind, lapply(miss_rows, `[[`, k))
  p_miss <- ggplot(part("trace"), aes(rtime, intensity)) +
    geom_rect(data = part("win"), aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey88") +
    geom_blank(data = part("lim")) +
    geom_vline(data = part("ms2"), aes(xintercept = rtime), colour = "firebrick",
               linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_rug(data = part("empty"), aes(x = rtime), inherit.aes = FALSE, sides = "b",
             colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.2, length = unit(0.04, "npc")) +
    geom_line(aes(group = run), linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = part("apex"), shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.5,
               colour = "#2166AC", fill = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~id, ncol = 4, scales = "free",
               labeller = as_labeller(setNames(vapply(miss_rows, `[[`, "", "label"),
                                               sprintf("%03d", seq_along(miss_rows))))) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
    labs(x = "retention time (s)", y = "MS1 intensity",
         caption = paste("Shaded: the window. Dashed: the file's confirmed MS2 spectra.",
                         "Circle: the apex the picker chose. Ticks: scans with no signal.")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0))
  ggsave(figp("step5_pc_misses.png"), p_miss, width = 7, height = miss_h, dpi = 200)
  ggsave(figp("step5_pc_misses.pdf"), p_miss, width = 7, height = miss_h)
  p_miss
} else {
  # The chapter collects this figure from both applications, so it is written even empty.
  p_none <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = miss_note, size = 3) + theme_void()
  ggsave(figp("step5_pc_misses.png"), p_none, width = 7, height = 1, dpi = 200)
  ggsave(figp("step5_pc_misses.pdf"), p_none, width = 7, height = 1)
}
```

`r miss_note`

## Files per assay, by MS2 and by MS1

For each assay and target, the files in which MS2 confirmed the target (the
positive control's rule) and the files in which MS1 detects its peak. The
chapter's examples of what extraction adds are read from this table.

```{r files-per-assay}
#| echo: false
per_assay <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(results), function(ds) {
  st <- all_samples_perfile[all_samples_perfile$dataset_id == ds, ]
  a  <- short_ds(ds, names(results))
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(roles, function(role) {
    pre <- target_prefix(role)
    data.frame(assay = a, compound = role, files = nrow(st),
               ms2 = sum(pc$confirmed[pc$dataset == a & pc$compound == role]),
               ms1 = sum(st[[paste0(pre, "_detected")]] %in% TRUE))
  }))
}))
write.csv(per_assay, "artifacts/files_per_assay.csv", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(per_assay, col.names = c("assay", "compound", "files",
                                      "MS2-confirmed files", "MS1-detected files"))
```

# Step summary

The results of this step, as the chapter's table shows them.

```{r step-summary}
# A file has a target by MS2 where one of its confirmed spectra came from it, and by
# MS1 where its peak was detected; a file counts when it has every target.
ms2_every <- sum(vapply(names(results), function(ds) {
  fb <- basename(as.character(bio_files_per_ds[[ds]]))
  k  <- norm_file_key(all_samples_perfile$file[all_samples_perfile$dataset_id == ds])
  confirmed <- function(role) k %in% norm_file_key(
    conf_final$source_file[conf_final$dataset_id == ds & conf_final$role == role], fb)
  sum(Reduce(`&`, lapply(roles, confirmed)))
}, integer(1)))
ms1_every <- sum(Reduce(`&`, lapply(prefixes, function(p)
  all_samples_perfile[[paste0(p, "_detected")]] %in% TRUE)))
# The hand corrections in curation/, counted for the datasets extracted here.
cur <- curation_inputs()
n_manual <- sum(cur$ov$dataset_id %in% names(results)) +
            sum(cur$drop_all$dataset %in% names(results)) +
            sum(cur$accept$dataset %in% names(results))

# The step's table counts files only; the recap rows (assays, deposits, MS1 over MS2)
# are for the discussion.
summary_step <- data.frame(
  item  = c("files extracted",
            paste("... with", targets_phrase(n_targets), "confirmed by MS2"),
            paste("... with", targets_phrase(n_targets), "detected in MS1"),
            "recap: assays", "recap: deposits",
            paste0("recap: ", targets_phrase(n_targets), ", MS1 over MS2")),
  value = c(nrow(all_samples_perfile), ms2_every, ms1_every,
            length(results),
            length(unique(ds_summary$deposit_id[ds_summary$dataset_id %in% names(results)])),
            sprintf("%.1f", ms1_every / ms2_every)))
write.csv(summary_step, "artifacts/summary_step5.csv", row.names = FALSE)
summary_step
```

Step 5 extracts `r length(results)` assays. Of the `r sum(pc$confirmed)` cases where
MS2 confirmed a target in a file, the positive control finds its MS1 peak in
`r sum(pc$detected)`. `r if (n_manual == 0) "No peak was corrected by hand." else paste(n_manual, if (n_manual == 1) "peak was" else "peaks were", "corrected by hand (curation/).")`
